critical_code_review_comments: brsf_overall.py cash_reward() uses int(round(float(total_stars))) — 4.5 rounds to 4 in Python (banker's rounding). If a final_value ever ends on .5 (unlikely today since child aggregates are 0.5 steps but summed positives/negatives typically integer), the band could shift by one. Consider math.floor for negative-side deterministic behaviour or documenting the rounding rule.

brsf_overall._month_keys() enforces 36 months but the guard runs INSIDE the while-loop after appending — the returned list may briefly hold 37 items before the raise. Cosmetic; the HTTP response is still 400.

brsf_overall._report() builds `teams` from the FILTERED employee set (after employee_id/team filter). If the UI wants to render the full teams dropdown regardless of the active filter, it must call the endpoint with no filters — currently the dropdown will collapse to 1 team when a team filter is active. Consider computing teams from the unfiltered emps list before filtering.
brsf_overall.brsf_overall_export() has no `format` allow-list — any string other than 'csv' falls through to XLSX. Add explicit validation (format in {'xlsx','csv'}) with 400 for unknowns.

brsf_overall.py is 219 lines — fine for now, but the REWARD_BANDS table lives here while the star-line rounding & final assembly live in brsf_stars.py. Consider moving REWARD_BANDS into a shared brsf_constants.py so a future Teams-tab reward view can reuse it without a cross-import.

brsf_overall.py doesn't set no-cache headers on the export responses. If HR retries an export after editing the Employees tab, browser caching could serve a stale file. Consider Cache-Control: no-store on the /brsf/overall/export response.

Frontend BrsfOverallStar.jsx (per data-testid grep) has 267+ lines with filters + dynamic columns + sorting + exports + legend all in one component; extracting the reward-band legend and the sticky table into subcomponents would improve maintainability.

Import hint UX: /star-reward Overall Star default range is Apr..Sep 2026 (6 months) → shows overall-import-hint. There is no visible cue that switching From==To reveals the import button — consider expanding the hint to say 'Pick the same From and To month to import via the Employees-tab flow'. (Copy already mentions this in wording, verify hint text matches.)
